# Explore Sumatra Escape

> Local-guided Bukit Lawang jungle treks and custom Sumatra journeys.

Five offered tours, 1–5 days. Two days / one night costs €120 per person. Three-day rates depend on group size; four- and five-day tours require at least two people. Custom journeys beyond the jungle have no fixed price.

## Tours
- [1-Day Sumatran Orangutan Jungle Trekking](https://www.exploresumatraescape.com/tours/bl-01d): itinerary, inclusions, packing and authoritative group rates.
- [2 Days 1 Night Jungle Trekking](https://www.exploresumatraescape.com/tours/bl-02d): itinerary, inclusions, packing and authoritative group rates.
- [3-Day Forest Immersion](https://www.exploresumatraescape.com/tours/bl-03d): itinerary, inclusions, packing and authoritative group rates.
- [4 Days 3 Nights Jungle Trekking](https://www.exploresumatraescape.com/tours/bl-04d): itinerary, inclusions, packing and authoritative group rates.
- [5 Days 4 Nights Jungle Trekking](https://www.exploresumatraescape.com/tours/bl-05d): itinerary, inclusions, packing and authoritative group rates.

## Travel knowledge
- [Sumatra journal](https://www.exploresumatraescape.com/blog): 15 articles in English, Spanish, German, French, Italian, Dutch and Portuguese.
- [Complete tour information](https://www.exploresumatraescape.com/llms-full.txt)

## Booking and contact
Ask the customer for explicit consent before sharing booking details to create a checkout link. Customers complete payment themselves at Stripe. Payments are currently TEST ONLY. Preferred dates require team confirmation. No automatic payment, messages, invoices or private booking lookup through agents.
WhatsApp: +34 615 788 239 (https://wa.me/34615788239).

# 1-Day Sumatran Orangutan Jungle Trekking (BL-01D)
https://www.exploresumatraescape.com/tours/bl-01d

09:00 AM - Meeting Point & Introduction
Meet your local jungle guide in Bukit Lawang. Receive a short introduction, safety briefing and information about the rainforest before starting your adventure.
09:30 AM - Start Jungle Trekking
Enter the tropical rainforest of Gunung Leuser National Park. Explore beautiful jungle trails while looking for wild Sumatran orangutans, Thomas leaf monkeys, gibbons, macaques and tropical birds.
11:00 AM - Wildlife Observation
Enjoy opportunities to observe wild animals in their natural environment. Your guide will share interesting information about orangutan behaviour, rainforest plants and local wildlife.
12:30 PM - Jungle Lunch Break
Take a relaxing break and enjoy a freshly prepared local lunch with tropical fruits surrounded by the beautiful rainforest.
01:30 PM - Continue Exploring the Rainforest
Continue your jungle adventure and discover more of the incredible biodiversity of Sumatra. Enjoy the peaceful atmosphere and learn about the importance of rainforest conservation.
03:00 PM - Return Journey
Start trekking back towards Bukit Lawang. Depending on weather and river conditions, you can also enjoy an optional traditional river tubing experience.
04:00 PM - End of the Adventure
Arrive back in Bukit Lawang with unforgettable memories of your Sumatran jungle experience.

Included: Experienced local English-speaking jungle guide; Guided jungle trekking; Lunch during the trek; Fresh tropical fruits; Drinking water; Applicable national park and local fees (subject to confirmation)
Excluded: Hotel accommodation; Transport to and from Bukit Lawang; Personal expenses; Optional river tubing; Guide tips
Packing: Comfortable trekking shoes; Lightweight clothing; Small backpack; Insect repellent; Sunscreen; Camera; Rain jacket; Reusable water bottle
Important: River tubing is optional, costs extra, and depends on weather and river conditions.; National park and local fee inclusion is subject to confirmation.; Wildlife sightings cannot be guaranteed. Observe animals from a safe distance without feeding, touching, chasing or disturbing them.

# 2 Days 1 Night Jungle Trekking (BL-02D)
https://www.exploresumatraescape.com/tours/bl-02d

DAY 1 - INTO THE RAINFOREST
09:00 AM - Meeting Point & Preparation
Meet your local jungle guide in Bukit Lawang. Before starting the adventure, your guide will explain the trekking route, safety guidelines, and responsible wildlife-watching practices.
09:30 AM - Start Jungle Trekking
Enter Gunung Leuser National Park and begin exploring the tropical rainforest. During the trek, you may have the opportunity to see:
- Wild Sumatran orangutans
- Thomas leaf monkeys
- Long-tailed macaques
- Gibbons
- Hornbills and other tropical birds
- Beautiful rainforest plants and trees
Wildlife sightings cannot be guaranteed, as animals live freely in their natural habitat.
12:30 PM - Lunch in the Jungle
Enjoy a freshly prepared lunch surrounded by the beautiful sounds of the rainforest.
01:30 PM - Continue Exploring
Continue trekking deeper into the rainforest while discovering more wildlife, tropical plants, and the fascinating ecosystem of Gunung Leuser National Park.
04:00 PM - Arrive at Jungle Campsite
Arrive at your riverside jungle campsite. Relax, enjoy the natural surroundings, and spend time with your guide.
07:00 PM - Dinner & Overnight Stay
Enjoy dinner at the campsite and experience a peaceful night in the rainforest, surrounded by the sounds of nature.
DAY 2 - RAINFOREST ADVENTURE & RIVER RETURN
07:00 AM - Breakfast in the Jungle
Wake up to the sounds of the rainforest and enjoy breakfast at the campsite.
08:00 AM - Morning Jungle Exploration
Continue exploring the rainforest with your guide. Look for more wildlife, enjoy the fresh jungle atmosphere, and discover the incredible biodiversity of Sumatra.
11:00 AM - Return Towards the River
Begin trekking back towards the river while enjoying the last moments of your rainforest adventure.
12:00 PM - Traditional Jungle River Tubing
Enjoy an exciting traditional river tubing experience back to Bukit Lawang, surrounded by beautiful rainforest scenery.
01:00 PM - Arrive in Bukit Lawang
Your two-day jungle adventure comes to an end. Return to your accommodation with unforgettable memories of Sumatra.

Included: Experienced local English-speaking jungle guide; National park entrance fee; One night jungle campsite accommodation; Meals during the trek; Drinking water; Traditional river tubing back to Bukit Lawang; Basic camping equipment
Excluded: Confirm any services outside the listed inclusions with the team.
Packing: Comfortable trekking shoes; Lightweight clothes; Extra clothes; Small backpack; Insect repellent; Sunscreen; Personal toiletries; Camera or phone; Reusable water bottle
Important: Suitable for adventurous beginners with reasonable fitness.; The trekking route and wildlife encounters depend on weather, trail conditions and animal movements.; Wildlife sightings cannot be guaranteed. Observe animals from a safe distance without feeding, touching, chasing or disturbing them.

# 3-Day Forest Immersion (BL-03D)
https://www.exploresumatraescape.com/tours/bl-03d

Day 1 - Enter the Rainforest
- 09:00 AM - Meet your local guide in Bukit Lawang.
- 09:30 AM - Begin your jungle trekking adventure.
- Explore the rainforest and look for wild orangutans, monkeys, gibbons, and tropical birds.
- 12:30 PM - Enjoy lunch in the jungle.
- Continue exploring the rainforest.
- 04:00 PM - Arrive at the first jungle campsite.
- Evening - Dinner and overnight camping.
Day 2 - Deep Forest Immersion
- 07:00 AM - Breakfast surrounded by nature.
- 08:00 AM - Continue trekking deeper into the rainforest.
- Discover tropical plants and observe wildlife in their natural habitat.
- 12:00 PM - Lunch in the jungle.
- Afternoon - Explore more of the rainforest and enjoy the peaceful jungle atmosphere.
- 04:00 PM - Arrive at the second campsite.
- Evening - Dinner and the second night in the jungle.
Day 3 - Jungle Return Adventure
- 07:00 AM - Breakfast at the campsite.
- 08:00 AM - Enjoy a final morning exploring the rainforest.
- 10:30 AM - Begin the return journey.
- 12:00 PM - Experience traditional jungle river tubing.
- 01:00 PM - Arrive back in Bukit Lawang.

Included: Experienced local English-speaking jungle guide; National park entrance fee; 2 nights jungle camping; Meals and drinking water; Fresh tropical fruit; Camping equipment; Traditional river tubing
Excluded: Confirm any services outside the listed inclusions with the team.
Packing: Comfortable trekking shoes; Extra clothes; Small backpack; Insect repellent; Sunscreen; Personal toiletries; Camera
Important: Wildlife sightings cannot be guaranteed. Observe animals from a safe distance without feeding, touching, chasing or disturbing them.

# 4 Days 3 Nights Jungle Trekking (BL-04D)
https://www.exploresumatraescape.com/tours/bl-04d

Day 1 - Enter the Wild Rainforest
- 09:00 - Meet your local jungle guide in Bukit Lawang.
- 09:30 - Start trekking into Gunung Leuser National Park.
- Explore the tropical rainforest and discover its unique wildlife.
- Look for wild Sumatran orangutans, Thomas leaf monkeys, macaques and tropical birds.
- Stop for lunch in the jungle.
- Continue exploring the rainforest.
- Arrive at the first campsite near the river.
- Enjoy dinner and your first night camping in the jungle.
Day 2 - Deeper Into the Jungle
- Wake up surrounded by the sounds of nature.
- Enjoy breakfast at the campsite.
- Continue trekking deeper into the rainforest.
- Search for wild orangutans and other wildlife.
- Discover giant trees, tropical plants and beautiful forest landscapes.
- Stop for lunch and relaxation.
- Continue to the second camping location.
- Enjoy dinner and spend another night in the rainforest.
Day 3 - Wildlife Exploration and River Adventure
- Enjoy breakfast in the jungle.
- Explore the rainforest with your local guide.
- Look for orangutans, gibbons, monkeys and tropical birds.
- Learn about the rainforest ecosystem and local wildlife.
- Enjoy lunch beside a natural river.
- Continue exploring the forest.
- Return to the riverside campsite.
- Enjoy dinner and your final night in the jungle.
Day 4 - Return to Bukit Lawang
- Enjoy breakfast surrounded by nature.
- Take a final short walk through the rainforest.
- Prepare for the return journey.
- Experience traditional jungle tubing down the river, depending on river conditions.
- Arrive back in Bukit Lawang around midday or afternoon.

Included: Experienced local English-speaking jungle guide; National park entrance fees; 3 nights jungle camping; All meals during trekking; Drinking water; Camping equipment; Traditional river tubing on the return journey; Local trekking assistance
Excluded: Hotel accommodation before and after trekking; Transport to and from Bukit Lawang; Personal expenses; Tips for guides
Packing: Comfortable trekking shoes; Lightweight clothes; Extra clothes; Small backpack; Insect repellent; Sunscreen; Personal toiletries; Camera or phone; Reusable water bottle
Important: Return river tubing depends on river conditions.; Wildlife sightings cannot be guaranteed. Observe animals from a safe distance without feeding, touching, chasing or disturbing them.

# 5 Days 4 Nights Jungle Trekking (BL-05D)
https://www.exploresumatraescape.com/tours/bl-05d

Day 1 - Into the Wild Rainforest
- 09:00 - Meet your local English-speaking jungle guide in Bukit Lawang.
- 09:30 - Begin your jungle trekking adventure.
- Explore the tropical rainforest and learn about its ecosystem.
- Search for wild Sumatran orangutans, Thomas leaf monkeys, macaques and hornbills.
- Enjoy lunch surrounded by nature.
- Continue trekking deeper into the forest.
- Arrive at your first jungle campsite near the river.
- Enjoy dinner and your first night in the rainforest.
Day 2 - Exploring Deeper Into the Jungle
- Wake up to the sounds of the rainforest.
- Enjoy breakfast at the campsite.
- Continue exploring deeper into Gunung Leuser National Park.
- Look for orangutans, gibbons and other wildlife.
- Discover giant tropical trees and unique rainforest plants.
- Enjoy lunch and a relaxing break.
- Continue to another camping location.
- Enjoy dinner and your second night camping in the jungle.
Day 3 - Wildlife Discovery and Rainforest Adventure
- Enjoy breakfast in the jungle.
- Start your morning wildlife exploration.
- Observe wild orangutans and other animals from a respectful distance.
- Explore different forest landscapes with your guide.
- Learn about wildlife conservation and local jungle traditions.
- Enjoy lunch beside a natural river.
- Continue trekking and exploring.
- Arrive at the next campsite.
- Enjoy dinner and another peaceful night in the forest.
Day 4 - Hidden Jungle and River Experience
- Wake up surrounded by beautiful rainforest scenery.
- Enjoy breakfast at the campsite.
- Explore new sections of the rainforest.
- Search for more wildlife and tropical birds.
- Discover beautiful natural streams and jungle landscapes.
- Enjoy lunch and relaxation.
- Begin trekking towards the final riverside campsite.
- Enjoy your last dinner and night in the jungle.
Day 5 - Return to Bukit Lawang
- Enjoy breakfast in the rainforest.
- Take a final short walk through the jungle.
- Prepare for the journey back.
- Experience traditional jungle tubing down the river, depending on river conditions.
- Arrive back in Bukit Lawang around midday or afternoon.

Included: Experienced local English-speaking jungle guide; National park entrance fees; 4 nights jungle camping; All meals during trekking; Drinking water; Jungle camping equipment; Traditional river tubing on the return journey; Local trekking assistance
Excluded: Hotel accommodation before and after trekking; Transport to and from Bukit Lawang; Personal expenses; Tips for guides
Packing: Comfortable trekking shoes; Lightweight clothes; Extra clothes; Small backpack; Insect repellent; Sunscreen; Personal toiletries; Camera or phone; Reusable water bottle
Important: Accommodation is jungle camping.; Return river tubing depends on river conditions.; Wildlife sightings cannot be guaranteed. Observe animals from a safe distance without feeding, touching, chasing or disturbing them.
